candidates.explanation: Timelock.executeWhitelisted is a 'list' create/registration flow that performs a callback-yielding interaction (.call{) BEFORE committing state (++, storage) and has no reentrancy guard. A reentrant call via the callback observes partially-initialized state (e.g. a stale per-address limit counter) and can bypass the invariant (nextgen H-01 class).
candidates.false_positive_controls: four-signal (create-verb fn + callback-yielding interaction + state-commit AFTER callback (ordering) + no nonReentrant guard); guarded/CEI-correct suppressed; cross-contract stale-check + Seaport-mediated are blind spots
